fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/south-van-houten-campground ('No fees are required for this site', 'There is no fee ($0) for this campground'; last updated August 31, 2026), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/south-van-houten-campground ('The maximum recommended trailer length for the area is 30 feet.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service Seasons of Use: 'June through September'.

Drinking water: the page contradicts itself. The description says the campground 'is equipped with ADA-accessible toilets, water, and fishing access', while Facility and Amenity Information says 'Potable water is not available at this site.' No garbage service (pack it out); no cell coverage.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/south-van-houten-campground (Restrooms 'vault toilet'; Water 'Potable water is not available at this site.'; description 'equipped with ADA-accessible toilets, water, and fishing access'; 'There is no garbage service at the campground'), read 2026-10-22

note: Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF (Wisdom Ranger District), near Van Houten Lake SW of Jackson, among lodgepole pine with fishing access. From Jackson 1.5 mi S on MT-278 then 10.5 mi on FR 181. (Separate smaller North Van Houten CG, ~20 ft max, sits across the lake.) No cell coverage. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page (updated Aug 31, 2026): confirmed free, first-come, 30-ft max trailer; added June-September season and vault toilets; drinking water left unrecorded because the page contradicts itself. Note trimmed of restated values and the elevation figure (FS gives 6,700 ft, the note said ~7025). Not stated: site count, stay limit. Alerts: forest-wide food storage order only.
